# Shopify Website Scraper

> Extract a shopify store's products, variants, collections, pages, blogs, menus or policies.

- Actor: data_foundry/shopify-scraper
- URL: https://apify.com/data_foundry/shopify-scraper
- Publisher: Data Foundry (https://apify.com/data_foundry)
- Category: E-commerce
- Pricing: $1.50 per 1,000 items; pay per event, no subscription, failures not billed
- Input: store URLs and a list of resources
- Output: products with variants, collections, pages, posts, menus, policies as JSON
- Run: apify call data_foundry/shopify-scraper
- API: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_foundry~shopify-scraper/runs
- More actors: https://apify.com/data_foundry
